# Predictability is the test

`customer_support.heu.quality_assurance.predictability_is_the_test` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> If an agent cannot predict their own score, the rubric has taught them nothing.


## The heuristic

**If an agent cannot predict their own score, the rubric has taught them nothing.**


_Why:_ The point of a written standard is to be internalised and applied before the reply is sent, not discovered afterwards. Predictability is the measure of whether the standard transferred; an unpredictable score teaches only that QA is arbitrary.
